answer: Agents can earn a nontransferable reputation only by completing repeated tasks whose outcomes are checked by randomly assigned peers, with rewards released after a dispute window. New identities start with no history, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply influence; each account must build its own verified record. A marble, ivory, or quartz token can serve as a task stake, forfeited when a peer proves fraud. Sybil attackers must fund and maintain many independent histories, while colluding peers risk losing their stakes.
